reviewer: Codex static review (model-assisted; not an independent human review)

criteria.rationale: The trigger is specific to proposed/completed diffs and explicitly excludes implementation ownership.
Inputs explicitly require approved scope, acceptance criteria, exact revision/diff, instructions, code context, and test evidence.
The review sequence is ordered and actionable, including full-diff inspection, causal tracing, evidence checks, and duplicate-finding removal.
The finding format requires severity, confidence, location, scenario, evidence, impact, recommendation, and verification.
Review is read-only; missing context and destructive tests are explicit stop conditions.
Two direct cases cover evidence-backed defects and style-only near misses; an edge/failure case is still missing.

gaps: Add an edge case for incomplete diff or unavailable test evidence.
summary: Static document review only. This score does not establish behavioral performance; runtime remains NOT_RUN.
